title: Lotus Sage Meditation
description: A blue-skinned figure with short white hair sits cross-legged on a massive purple lotus pad floating on dark water. The figure holds a glowing orb containing a four-leaf clover in one hand and an ornate staff topped with a lotus flower in the other, while purple smoke rises from their shoulders.
prompt: A serene blue-skinned mystical figure with short white hair sits in lotus position on an enormous purple and green lily pad in the middle of a misty swamp at dusk. The figure holds a glowing purple orb with a bright four-leaf clover inside one hand and an ornate dark staff with a lotus blossom top in the other. Purple ethereal smoke rises from the shoulders. Golden god rays shine down from the twilight sky. Water lilies, dragonflies, and reflections visible on the water surface. Cinematic fantasy style, detailed, atmospheric lighting.
